operations.title: A selected cocycle can descend without a Betti homology map
operations.statement: For a target n-cocycle ell and graded map S, ell S_n defines a functional on source H_n iff ell Omega_(n+1)=0. This is strictly weaker than Omega=0 and weaker than S inducing H_n(G)->H_n(H).

operations.title: Selected readout survives a noncycle Betti image
operations.procedure: Map the source Z cycle generator to (1,1) in target Z^2 --[1 0]--> Z and pair with ell=[0 1].
operations.outcome: The Betti image is not a cycle, so no target homology map exists, while ell gives the nonzero well-defined source-homology readout 1.
operations.falsifier: This falsifies the inference that every descended selected readout requires a full Betti homology map.
